programme.title: Sue Perkins Big Adventure: Paris to Istanbul
programme.desc: In her trans-continental adventure, comedian Sue Perkins starts in Paris where she cycles, samples gourmet insects, enjoys absinthe, struts at Fashion Week, and embraces her inner burlesque dancer.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: Father Brown investigates when a medieval murder is committed at a battle re-enactment.

programme.title: Nigella: At My Table
programme.desc: Nigella shares new discoveries like her Turkish-inspired eggs, old-fashioned favourites including the aptly named Queen of Puddings, as well as her emergency brownies, plus a chicken and pea tray-bake.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Kathryn Robinson brings you today's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter.

programme.title: Landline
programme.desc: A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

programme.title: Back Roads
programme.desc: Back Roads heads along the legendary Oodnadatta Track in outback South Australia. Heather Ewart begins her journey in the small town of Marree, where the Oodnadatta and Birdsville Tracks meet.

programme.title: Julia Zemiro's Home Delivery
programme.desc: Former track and field star Raelene Boyle takes Julia to her childhood home and to her primary school in Coburg Victoria, where they chat about her early family life and the beginnings of her sporting career.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: This week all six filmmakers land in the same country, Japan. With 40 million tourists a year and a land "teeming with stories," the episode promises something different from the usual solo dispatches.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: A dead body and a piece of parchment lead Murdoch and Crabtree to follow a suspect named Jacob Doyle to his home in Newfoundland.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Two incredible stories: a mother living with a heart-breaking decision made when she was still a child, to give up her son for adoption; and a woman on a quest to solve a family mystery and find her sisters. (Final)

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The magnificent Castle Howard in Yorkshire is their first stop as visitors raid their attics to bring in family heirlooms to show the experts. A diamond brooch draws gasps of delight as the owners are advised of the value.

programme.title: Hard Quiz
programme.desc: Quizzing hard with Tom Gleeson are Kylie Minogue fan Erwin, Bathurst 1000 fanatic Gavin, The Office tragic Cale, and cremation expert Christine. Don't mix these topics at home.

programme.title: ABC News VIC
programme.desc: News from where we live. ABC News Victoria brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on issues that matter to Victorians. Presented by Ben Knight, and weather with Adam Morgan.

Sarah Ferguson presents Australia's premier daily current affairs program, delivering agenda-setting public affairs journalism and interviews that hold the powerful to account. Plus political analysis from Jacob Greber.

programme.title: Australian Story
programme.desc: When teenager Mark Haines was discovered dead on train tracks near the NSW town of Tamworth, his uncle was convinced it was foul play. Four decades later, a new inquest reveals fresh evidence and a cover-up.

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: Adele Ferguson follows the trail from Australian supermarkets to international supply chains, revealing how products can be adulterated long before they reach the shopping trolley or are linked to unethical labour practices.

programme.title: Media Watch
programme.desc: Australia's leading forum for media analysis and comment. Walkley award-winning investigative reporter and former foreign correspondent Linton Besser brings you a fearless critique of the week's journalism.

programme.title: If You're Listening
programme.desc: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump want a resort on protected flamingo habitat in Albania. Thousands are protesting in the Flamingo Revolution. Albania has been burned by get-rich-quick schemes before, and isn't buying it twice.

programme.title: Foreign Correspondent
programme.desc: Norway is the biggest salmon producer in the world. It invented the farmed salmon industry and built it into an 18-billion-dollar business. But meeting the growing global appetite for salmon doesn't come without consequences.

programme.title: ABC Late News
programme.desc: End your day with the latest on the day's top stories. ABC News has reporters across Australia and around the globe to uncover what's happening and why it matters. Presented by Craig Smart in Perth.

programme.title: The Business
programme.desc: Australia's leading daily business and finance show, bringing you up to date on market moves, economic trends and the forces affecting consumers, employees and business owners big and small. Presented by Kirsten Aiken.

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: A dead body and a piece of parchment lead Murdoch and Crabtree to follow a suspect named Jacob Doyle to his home in Newfoundland.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: Two incredible stories: a mother living with a heart-breaking decision made when she was still a child, to give up her son for adoption; and a woman on a quest to solve a family mystery and find her sisters. (Final)

programme.title: rage Charts
programme.desc: Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

programme.title: Gardening Australia
programme.desc: Costa is bowled over by terrific turf; Clarence traces a green web of gardens; Hannah tours a downsized productive patch; Jerry shares bulbs for the subtropics; Millie renovates a wheelbarrow; we meet bird-loving ecologist.

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan and his team come to the rescue of a lady in Hampshire suffering from a life threatening illness. As a result her garden has suffered and is far from the sanctuary she craves.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The magnificent Castle Howard in Yorkshire is their first stop as visitors raid their attics to bring in family heirlooms to show the experts. A diamond brooch draws gasps of delight as the owners are advised of the value.

programme.title: ABC News Breakfast
programme.desc: News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, interviews and sport. Plus weather with Nate Byrne. Don't just start your day informed, start your day in front.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings
programme.desc: Stay in the know with what's happening this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Gemma Veness.

programme.title: Australian Story
programme.desc: When teenager Mark Haines was discovered dead on train tracks near the NSW town of Tamworth, his uncle was convinced it was foul play. Four decades later, a new inquest reveals fresh evidence and a cover-up.

programme.title: Kitchen Cabinet
programme.desc: Annabel visits Angus Taylor - the ninth Liberal leader this century - who has a Herculean task ahead as he grapples with the growth of One Nation and the collapse in the Coalition's vote. And now he has to cook on camera.

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Victorian Murder Club

programme.desc: Jazz At Twilight is a nightly playlist programmed to accompany your twilight hours.

programme.title: Jazz Unwind
programme.desc: Ease into a mix of serene textures and sounds your daily dose of relaxing jazz.

programme.title: Jazz After Hours
programme.desc: Accompanying nocturnal and hibernating Jazz Cats around Australia.

programme.title: Jazz Breakfast
programme.desc: Softly as in a morning sunrise: jump into the day with a mix of energizing tunes curated by ABC Jazz.

programme.title: Essential Jazz
programme.desc: Discover important and influential names in improvised music with a showcase of great tunes from across the history of jazz.
